description: Solidity ABI encoding (like abi.encode): address, bool, uint8-256, int8-256, bytes1-32, bytes, string, dynamic T[] and fixed T[k] arrays, and tuples written (uint256,address), nested to any depth. Strict: exact 20-byte (checksum-valid) addresses, range-checked integers, exact bytesN length, JSON true/false for bool, JSON arrays for arrays and tuples. Integers as decimal strings (or safe JSON numbers). Price: $0.01 USDC per call on Base mainnet ($0.001 on Base Sepolia), paid with x402; failed calls are not charged.
